title: Per-agent identity & delegation on every action (SPIFFE, OAuth token exchange, MCP auth, IETF agent drafts)
outcome: A recommended scheme that binds every action to one agent identity, through delegation chains and shared tools, and can be revoked fast
acceptance: ≥5 primary sources with URLs (specs/RFCs/drafts with version: SPIFFE, RFC 8693, MCP authorization spec, draft-klrc-aiagent-auth, RFC 9421 or similar)
Table comparing ≥4 approaches on: granularity (workload vs action), delegation chain support, non-repudiation, revocation latency, prototype effort
Explicit analysis of where attribution collapses (shared MCP server / service credentials) and how to keep it
'Implications for our design' section with a recommended identity + action-signing scheme for Identity and Containment
